$comment: SSOT for UI/API port assignments and stack pairings. Used by dev-start.sh.

client-reporting.$note: Standalone client-reporting-ui archived under workspace-root archive/. Client reporting surfaces are integrated into unified-trading-system-ui.

user-management.$note: ARCHIVED: auth-api removed. Auth is Firebase-based (VITE_SKIP_AUTH in mock, Firebase OAuth in real). User management routes in unified-trading-api.

unified-trading.$note: Canonical UI + consolidated domain API (two-API model with deployment-api). UI: Next.js dev on :3000 (default mock), :3100 (real-API server, per next.config.mjs:9). Auth is Firebase, not a separate service. Legacy split UIs archived. Updated 2026-05-12 per UI-5 audit (was :5174 — Vite legacy).

auth.$note: ARCHIVED: auth-api removed. Authentication handled by Firebase. DISABLE_AUTH=true in mock mode, Firebase JWT validation in real mode.

service_workers.$comment: Backend services that are NOT part of a UI/API stack but required for SIT and local integration tests. extra_args are appended to 'python -m <module>' by dev-start.sh.

execution-service.$note: FIX engine. Uses 8018 for local dev (avoids collision with other API stacks). Runs live execution mode in dev.

risk-and-exposure-service.$note: Reads mode from MODE env var (set to 'live' by dev-start.sh via DEV_RUNTIME_MODE mapping). No CLI args needed.

position-balance-monitor-service.$note: CLI requires --operation and --mode. --skip-startup-recon avoids exchange API calls in dev.

alerting-service.$note: Uses __main__.py entry point (python -m alerting_service). CLI requires --mode.

pnl-attribution-service.$note: Uses __main__.py entry point (python -m pnl_attribution_service). Pass --serve to start the health API server.

market-tick-data-service.$note: Requires --mode. --dry-run prevents cloud writes in local dev.

instruments-service.$note: CLI requires --mode and --run-mode. aggregate+batch requires no dates (delta-only default).

agent-orchestrator.$note: FastAPI orchestrator for parallel Claude Code worker agents. Boot via uvicorn (not python -m): `uvicorn server.server:app --port 8765`. Dashboard is a separate Vite app at agent-orchestrator/dashboard/ (npm run dev), default port 5173 in scripts/dev.sh. Cloud Run target uses PORT=8080 internally per Dockerfile. Operator tooling — exempt from QG STEPs 5.61 + 5.34 per plans/active/agent_orchestrator_cloud_run_deployment_2026_05_19.md.
